description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractConfig' that manages common configuration properties for client and server components within the Eclipse Hono project. It provides mechanisms to handle trust store and key store paths, passwords, file formats, and secure protocols, along with methods for deriving trust and key/cert options used for SSL/TLS setup.

classes.name: AbstractConfig
classes.description: An abstract configuration class providing methods to handle SSL/TLS properties such as trust store, key store, and secure protocols for client and server components.

methods.name: isValidPort
methods.description: Checks if a given port number is within the valid range (0-65535).

methods.name: getPathSeparator
methods.description: Returns the character used to separate segments in target addresses.

methods.name: setPathSeparator
methods.description: Sets the character used to separate segments in target addresses.

methods.name: getTrustStorePath
methods.description: Returns the file path of the trust store.

methods.name: setTrustStorePath
methods.description: Sets the file path of the trust store.

methods.name: getTrustStorePassword
methods.description: Returns the trust store password as a String.

methods.name: setTrustStorePassword
methods.description: Sets the trust store password.

methods.name: getTrustOptions
methods.description: Constructs and returns TrustOptions based on trust store properties, detecting format and loading certificates accordingly.

methods.name: getKeyStorePath
methods.description: Returns the path to the keystore.

methods.name: setKeyStorePath
methods.description: Sets the path to the keystore.

methods.name: getKeyStorePassword
methods.description: Returns the keystore password.

methods.name: setKeyStorePassword
methods.description: Sets the keystore password.

methods.name: getKeyCertOptions
methods.description: Creates and provides KeyCertOptions based on configured key, cert files or keystore, including format detection and validation.

methods.name: getCertPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the PEM certificate file.

methods.name: setCertPath
methods.description: Sets the path to the PEM certificate file.

methods.name: getKeyPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the PEM key file.

methods.name: setKeyPath
methods.description: Sets the path to the PEM key file.

methods.name: setTrustStoreFormat
methods.description: Specifies the format of the trust store explicitly.

methods.name: getTrustStoreFormat
methods.description: Returns the format of the trust store, or null if auto-detection is enabled.

methods.name: setKeyFormat
methods.description: Specifies the explicit format of key material files.

methods.name: getKeyFormat
methods.description: Returns the format of key material files or null if auto-detection is enabled.

methods.name: getSecureProtocols
methods.description: Returns the list of enabled secure protocols for TLS, defaulting to TLSv1.2.

methods.name: setSecureProtocols
methods.description: Sets the list of protocols to enable for TLS connections.
